title: Renewable Swift Sneak
description: Killing a Warden has a chance of dropping a Swift Sneak book
body:
This datapack adds the chance that Wardens, when killed by a player, drop a Swift Sneak book.

The odds are:
- 70%: No enchanted book drop
- 10%: Swift Sneak 1
- 10%: Swift Sneak 2
- 10%: Swift Sneak 3

All wardens continue to drop a single Sculk Catalyst on death (the vanilla default).
